completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: Continuous closed-loop Paper bot engineering guard
active_mission.objective: Continuously keep the Hixton Paper-only system internally consistent. Current owner priority: optimize and diagnose all ten active V6 coin profiles individually with the real 10x250 isolated three-year backtest, then recompute the same strategy definition in the shared 3x80 portfolio. Every accepted per-coin profile change must propagate through the single canonical strategy definition used by Paper, isolated batch, shared portfolio and UI. Diagnose losing trades and candidate filters/stops per coin using train/validation separation and cost stress; do not cherry-pick on validation. Preserve ranked_repeat 3x80 slot semantics, no permanent portfolio drawdown halt, and the 5-percent UTC-day pause. In parallel audit and repair all DMS documents so current normative statements match the active USDC V6 implementation; historical sections must remain clearly labelled as historical.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: Owner instruction 2026-09-19: start the full ten-coin isolated 10x250 optimization cycle now. Diagnose every coin's losing trades and drawdown, select candidates only on training windows, validate separately under baseline/stress costs, assemble one canonical profile map, and recompute the same unchanged profile map in the shared 3x80 portfolio. Any accepted coin improvement must propagate to Paper, isolated batch and shared portfolio through the same V6 strategy definition.
constraints: Run in GitHub-hosted virtual environments; no owner laptop dependency.
The eleven cloud roles must run without OpenAI/API secrets; their default mode is deterministic verification and supervision.
Trading mode is permanently Paper-only for this project phase: real public Binance market data, simulated orders/fills, persistent Paper account state.
Never send real or testnet exchange orders and never request Binance account credentials.
Do not replace real Binance candles with synthetic market data for operational Paper evaluation; deterministic fixtures remain allowed only for unit/regression tests.

A research-only pre-listing market proxy may use real public Binance USDT candles for the same base assets only when it is explicitly labelled as proxy evidence and never presented as historical USDC liquidity or fills.
Every material extension must emit role-specific evidence rather than only a PASS flag.
A10 must reject missing/stale specialist evidence, incomplete regression coverage, or an active mission left at NEW after work has started, and route the defect into repair.
A11 must independently verify the evidence contract, A10 repair state and A09 QA gate before GOVERNANCE_PASS.

A known-safe lifecycle defect where an active mission is still NEW may be normalized automatically to IN_PROGRESS before specialist execution; no other autonomous repository mutation is implied by that repair.
Audit every active-bot occurrence of legacy USDT market symbols; historical evidence and explicit legacy-rejection guards may remain but must never become active runtime configuration.
Keep the historic USDT and fresh-start USDT/USDC references distinct; never compare a carried account path to a fresh start as if they were equivalent.

The owner-approved normal 3x80 capacity semantics supersede the older one-slot-per-symbol execution assumption for V6: use all free slots on currently valid ranked candidates, including repeat allocation to the strongest candidate when fewer distinct candidates exist.
Do not fabricate additional strategy signals. Multiple slots assigned to one signal are multiple 80-USDC capacity tranches of one signal cycle and must be reported as such.
Repair only proven implementation/configuration/data/reporting defects; do not tune the strategy merely to force a historical target.
Keep failed candidates, losing windows and contradictory evidence visible.
If fresh evidence cannot distinguish a defect from a modelling choice, document the exact unresolved question for the owner instead of guessing.
After any repair, rerun all eleven roles before completion is claimed.
Remove the persistent 20-percent portfolio drawdown halt from active V6 Paper and shared-portfolio backtest entry gating; keep drawdown calculation and reporting.
Keep the 5-percent UTC-day loss pause, emergency stop, cash limits, exchange filters, stale-data and execution safety gates unchanged.
Optimize coins only through explicit versioned candidate profiles; use training windows for selection and a separate validation window for acceptance.

A candidate that improves one isolated coin is not accepted solely on that result; the assembled ten-coin candidate set must be rerun in the shared 3x80 portfolio with identical costs, window and execution semantics.
The same canonical profile map must feed 10x250 isolated backtests, 3x80 shared portfolio, Paper runtime and UI. No shadow profile map or backtest-only override may be activated.

Shared-portfolio return is not mathematically required to increase for every isolated improvement because slot competition can change which signals receive capital; however any accepted profile change must be provably present in the recomputed portfolio inputs and resulting signal/fill trace.

Audit every DMS file. Current normative statements must use USDC, ranked_repeat 3x80 semantics, separate position-cycle versus slot-trade counts, no permanent 20-percent portfolio halt, and canonical 10x250-to-3x80 profile propagation. Preserve dated historical evidence as historical rather than rewriting its original results.
acceptance: All eleven roles participate in every material guard run and emit fresh role-specific evidence for their assigned layer.
All eleven default cloud roles execute without OpenAI or Binance private API credentials.
A01 validates mission state, requirements and Paper-only invariants before specialist evidence can be accepted.

A02 runs the owner slot-capacity regression and verifies that one ranked candidate can consume three free slots, two candidates consume 2+1, and three candidates consume 1+1+1 while preserving the same signal rules.
A02 records unique completed position cycles separately from completed slot-equivalent round trips so repeated slots are not hidden in the trade count.
A03 verifies that Paper and shared-portfolio backtest use the same active V6 slot-allocation policy and preserve persisted slot_count without resetting the Paper account.
A04 verifies that UI/report wording does not present position-cycle count as the complete slot-trade count when repeated slots are active.
A05 continuously verifies Paper ledger integrity and freshness and fails on stale state.
A06 executes the full integration/regression suite after changes and exposes failures rather than masking them.
A07 verifies all ten real public Binance USDC markets and current public candle access without private credentials and records the actual common-history start imposed by listing/data availability.
A09 performs fresh full Python and UI QA and issues QA_PASS only after A01-A08 and A10 are clean.
A10 verifies the mission-specific evidence matrix, detects lifecycle/evidence drift, and reports repair_required=false only when every required specialist category is actually covered.
A11 independently rechecks the mission-specific evidence matrix, QA_PASS, A10 repair state and Paper-only contract before GOVERNANCE_PASS.
An active mission cannot silently remain NEW once specialist work begins; the lifecycle guard either repairs the known-safe NEW-to-IN_PROGRESS transition or the run fails closed.
The 10x250 isolated diagnostic remains separately labelled and is not misrepresented as the same account/risk model as 3x80.

A clearly labelled three-year continuity research run evaluates the current USDC strategy over the full historical period using real same-base-asset public market proxy data where USDC listing history is unavailable, while explicitly stating that the proxy is not historical USDC liquidity or execution evidence.
A08 verifies that the 5-percent daily pause remains active while the persistent 20-percent portfolio drawdown halt no longer blocks entries.

The real three-year 3x80 dashboard portfolio run and 10x250 isolated run use the same report window and expose per-coin isolated trade counts, portfolio position cycles, slot-trades, ending equity, max drawdown and blocked-entry reasons.
The repaired 3x80 three-year run reports zero MAX_DRAWDOWN_20_PERCENT blocked entries and no persistent risk_halted_at_utc.
A01-A11 all rerun after the repair; A09 must issue QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS before the patch is considered downloadable.
No real-money order path is enabled and no automatic merge occurs.

For each of the ten coins, produce current baseline diagnostics: completed trades, wins/losses, realized PnL, return, max drawdown, holding-time/loss-pattern evidence and blocked-signal reasons where applicable.
Per-coin candidate selection uses training data only; validation and stress results are reported after selection and cannot trigger silent reselection.
The assembled ten-coin candidate profile set is versioned once and used unchanged by a fresh 10x250 batch and fresh 3x80 shared-portfolio run on the same report window.
A parity proof records the exact per-symbol parameter/policy hashes used by both 10x250 and 3x80 and fails if they differ.

If the 3x80 result is unchanged after a profile change, evidence must show whether the modified coin produced an identical shared-portfolio signal/fill path because of slot competition; otherwise treat the unchanged result as a parity defect.
All 27 DMS files are scanned; every current contradictory normative statement is repaired, while historical dated sections remain explicitly historical.
After code/profile/DMS changes, rerun the real 10x250, real 3x80, full Python/UI regression and A01-A11 with A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS.
